context: Hina-young and Sho-young have a tender sibling moment about growing up.
purpose: Two siblings reflecting maturely on their bond.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 翔、いつの間にか、大きくなった。
lines.en: Sho, when did you get so tall?
lines.style: Warm, almost amazed. Soft wonder on the observation itself. Voice holds something tender underneath—the realization of time passing. Gentle and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえちゃん、もうすぐ、大人。
lines.en: Big sis, I'm almost grown up already.
lines.style: Small, quiet voice. Slight awe at his own words. Matter-of-fact but with an undertone of not quite understanding what that means. Genuine and unguarded.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん、寂しいような、嬉しいような。
lines.en: Yeah… it's sad and happy at the same time.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft voice exploring the feeling as she says it. Slight upward lilt on the contradiction—acknowledging both truths at once. Trailing off with acceptance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Direct and simple. Quiet conviction underneath. No performance—just the truth stated small and clear. Warm but unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I really feel the same way.
lines.style: Meeting his sincerity with her own. Soft but steady. Slight emphasis on 'really'—confirming that yes, this matters to her too. Voice steady and sure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright and open, but grounded. Small boy certainty in the words. No doubt in the statement—just offering it as fact. Warm and secure.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Echo of his words but softer. Thoughtful, like a promise she's making to herself and to him. Quiet ending—not trailing off but settling into certainty. Gentle hold on the final word.
